vertical-align: top; width: 37px"&gt;c.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;The consolidated financial statements comprise the financial statements of companies that are controlled by the Company (subsidiaries). Control is achieved when the Company is exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its involvement with the investee and has the ability to affect those returns through its power over the investee. The consolidation of the financial statements commences on the date on which control is obtained and ends when such control ceases.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="zf0796c77eced4d49b8f27832751a6d1d" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 56.7pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 37px"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;The financial statements of the Company and of the subsidiaries are prepared as of the same dates and periods. The consolidated financial statements are prepared using uniform accounting policies by all companies in the Group. Significant intercompany balances and transactions and gains or losses resulting from intercompany transactions are eliminated in full in the consolidated financial statements.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/table&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfOtherAccountingPoliciesRelevantToUnderstandingOfFinancialStatements>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForForeignCurrencyTranslationExplanatory contextRef="From2017-01-01to2017-12-31">&lt;div&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;table id="z6d746f60e38f4bce8f009698ef60bb66" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.35pt"&gt;d.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Functional currency, presentation currency and foreign currency&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="z36181b8a369b42a084cdb3cf5d037ab3" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 85.05pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.5pt"&gt;1.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Functional currency and presentation currency&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;The consolidated financial statements are presented in U.S. dollars, which is the Company's functional and presentation currency.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="za1e2dba151c84002adb9d0f5c037ec2d" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 85.05pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.5pt"&gt;2.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Transactions, assets and liabilities in foreign currency&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;Transactions denominated in foreign currency are recorded on initial recognition at the exchange rate at the date of the transaction. After initial recognition, monetary assets and liabilities denominated in foreign currency are translated at the end of each reporting period into the functional currency at the exchange rate at that date. Exchange differences are recognized in profit or loss. Non-monetary assets and liabilities measured at cost in a foreign currency are translated at the exchange rate at the date of the transaction.&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForForeignCurrencyTranslationExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyToDetermineComponentsOfCashAndCashEquivalents contextRef="From2017-01-01to2017-12-31">&lt;div&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;table id="z5060e43e25da45729cbe1ec530e83221" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.35pt"&gt;e.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Cash equivalents&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;Cash equivalents are considered as highly liquid investments, including unrestricted short-term bank deposits with an original maturity of three months or less from the date of purchase.&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyToDetermineComponentsOfCashAndCashEquivalents>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForInvestmentsOtherThanInvestmentsAccountedForUsingEquityMethodExplanatory contextRef="From2017-01-01to2017-12-31">&lt;div&gt;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt; text-indent: -28.35pt"&gt;f.&amp;#160; &amp;#160;&amp;#160;&amp;#160; &amp;#160;&amp;#160; &lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Short-term investments:&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;Short-term bank deposits with a maturity of more than three months from the deposit date but less than one year, available for sale financial investments (debentures)&amp;#160; and financial assets held for trading at fair value through profit or loss (debentures and stocks).&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForInvestmentsOtherThanInvestmentsAccountedForUsingEquityMethodExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForTradeAndOtherReceivablesExplanatory contextRef="From2017-01-01to2017-12-31">&lt;div&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;table id="z89ee2cd253004751a4d056a9772c9019" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.35pt"&gt;g.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Allowance for doubtful accounts&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;The allowance for doubtful accounts is determined in respect of specific debts whose collection, in the opinion of the Company's management, is doubtful. Impaired debts are derecognized when they are assessed as uncollectible. As of December 31, 2017 there was no allowance for doubtful accounts and as of December 31, 2016, the balance of allowance for doubtful accounts was $399 thousands.&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForTradeAndOtherReceivablesExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForMeasuringInventories contextRef="From2017-01-01to2017-12-31">&lt;div&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;table id="z45de547334474350b7cb0deb24796a46" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.35pt"&gt;h.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Inventories&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;Inventories are measured at the lower of cost and net realizable value. The cost of inventories comprises costs of purchase of raw and other materials and costs incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition. Net realizable value is the estimated selling price in the ordinary course of business.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;Cost of inventories is determined as follows:&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: left"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;div id="DSPFPageHeader"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="z63133e895cc94a298168b64539bec4d8" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 114px"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 142px"&gt;&#13;&lt;div&gt;Raw materials&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 28px"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; text-align: left; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div&gt;At cost using the first-in, first-out method.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="zb1dec1919e884b6da6ef9844a89442c8" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 114px"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 142px"&gt;&#13;&lt;div&gt;Work in process&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 28px"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; text-align: left; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div&gt;Direct costs and indirect costs calculated at average costs for the quarter of manufacturing including materials, labor and other direct and indirect manufacturing costs on the basis of each batch.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="ze4ac42b51222465f9b1bd24160d86c11" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 114px"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 142px"&gt;&#13;&lt;div&gt;Finished products&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 28px"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; text-align: left; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div&gt;Direct costs and indirect costs calculated at average costs for quarter of manufacturing including materials, labor and other direct and indirect manufacturing costs on the basis of each batch.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="zdfbac232322f47108a5de7a33286aa5b" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 114px"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 142px"&gt;&#13;&lt;div&gt;Purchased products&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 28px"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;-&lt;/font&gt;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; text-align: left; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div&gt;At cost on a "first in &amp;#8211; first out" basis.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;The Company periodically evaluates the condition and age of inventories and accounts for impairment of inventories with a lower market value or which are slow moving.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Research and development costs&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;Research expenditures are recognized in profit or loss when incurred. An intangible asset arising from a development project or from the development phase of an internal project is recognized if the Company can demonstrate the technical feasibility of completing the intangible asset so that it will be available for use or sale; the Company's intention to complete the intangible asset and use or sell it; the Company's ability to use or sell the intangible asset; how the intangible asset will generate future economic benefits; the availability of adequate technical, financial and other resources to complete the intangible asset; and the Company's ability to measure reliably the expenditure attributable to the intangible asset during its development. Since the Company development projects are often subject to regulatory approval procedures and other uncertainties, the conditions for the capitalization of costs incurred before receipt of approvals are not normally satisfied and therefore, development expenditures are recognized in profit or loss when incurred&lt;/font&gt;.&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForMeasuringInventories>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForRecognitionOfRevenue contextRef="From2017-01-01to2017-12-31">&lt;div&gt;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: left"&gt;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;table id="z8325adc558fe445b990152a8e7532d32" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 28.35pt"&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;i&lt;/font&gt;&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Revenue recognition&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;Revenues are recognized in profit or loss when the revenues can be measured reliably, it is probable that the economic benefits associated with the transaction will flow to the Company and the costs incurred or to be incurred in respect of the transaction can be measured reliably. In cases where the Company operates as a principal supplier and it exposed to the risks and rewards associated with the transaction, revenues are presented on a gross basis. Revenues are measured at the fair value of the consideration received less any trade discounts, volume rebates and returns.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;The specific criteria for revenue recognition for the following types of revenues are:&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="z4c1ede24f2f94345a4d48cd8d86bbc89" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 113px"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 27px"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.25"&gt;-&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;Revenues from the sale of goods are recognized when all the significant risks and rewards of ownership of the goods have passed to the buyer and the seller no longer retains continuing managerial involvement. The delivery date is usually the date on which ownership passes.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="z9d78d1fcb99740d99226caac8c85b6fb" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 113px"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 27px"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.25"&gt;-&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;Agreements with multiple elements provide for varying consideration terms, such as upfront payments and milestone payments. Revenues from such agreements that do not contain a general right of return and that are composed of multiple elements such as distribution exclusivity, license and services are allocated to the different elements and&amp;#160; are recognized in respect of each element separately. An element constitutes a separate accounting unit if and only if it has a separate value to the customer. Revenue from the different element is recognized when the criteria for revenue recognition have been met and only to the extent of the consideration that is not contingent upon completion or performance of future services in the contract.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; font: small-caps bold 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="zbe3bc7fd05694c37abe4a66f12018828" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 142px"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: left"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify"&gt;Revenue from milestone and upfront events stipulated in the agreements is recognized upon the occurrence of a substantive element specified in the agreement or as a measure of substantive progress towards completion.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="z374a21f16b7149c89d00fc205e0c3d1d" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr style="vertical-align: top"&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; width: 142px"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: left"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;In&lt;font style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt; events that the Company receives at no charge raw material, that is required for manufacturing one of the Company's products, the Company recorded the fair value of the raw material used and sold as revenue and charged the same fair value to cost of revenue.&lt;/font&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;div id="DSPFPageHeader"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Deferred revenues&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;Deferred revenues include unearned amounts received from customers not yet recognized as revenues.&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForRecognitionOfRevenue>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForIncomeTaxExplanatory contextRef="From2017-01-01to2017-12-31">&lt;div&gt;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: left"&gt;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;table id="z5377ca3547444d9a8d784d515925c01f" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.35pt"&gt;j.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Taxes on income&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;Taxes on income in profit or loss comprise current and deferred taxes. Current or deferred taxes are recognized in profit or loss, except to the extent that the tax arises from items which are recognized directly in other comprehensive income or in equity.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="zc2ffd3ea9ba341ef89f58ffd6bf654d1" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 85.05pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.5pt"&gt;1.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;Current taxes:&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;The current tax liability is measured using the tax rates and tax laws that have been enacted or substantively enacted by the end of reporting period as well as adjustments required in connection with the tax liability in respect of previous years.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="z09f2e64028e14ca9a5843a634eda0d66" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 85.05pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.5pt"&gt;2.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;Deferred taxes:&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;Deferred taxes are computed in respect of temporary differences between the carrying amounts in the financial statements and the amounts attributed for tax purposes.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;Deferred taxes are measured at the tax rates that are expected to apply when the asset is realized or the liability is settled, based on tax laws that have been enacted or substantively enacted by the end of the reporting period.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;Deferred tax assets are reviewed at the end of each reporting period and reduced to the extent that it is not probable that they will be utilized. Temporary differences for which deferred tax assets had not been recognized are reviewed at the end of each reporting period and a respective deferred tax asset is recognized to the extent that their utilization is probable.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;Deferred taxes are offset in the statement of financial position if there is a legally enforceable right to offset a current tax asset against a current tax liability and the deferred taxes relate to the same taxpayer and the same taxation authority.&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForIncomeTaxExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForLeasesExplanatory contextRef="From2017-01-01to2017-12-31">&lt;div&gt;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: left"&gt;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;table id="z5b2e1366b1414e1a8ff7e1f0eb31bddb" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.35pt"&gt;k.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Leases&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.55pt; text-indent: -28.5pt"&gt;&lt;u&gt;The Group as lessee:&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="z0fb158df309b4d559784be16f799bdc0" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 85.05pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.5pt"&gt;1.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Finance lease&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;Finance leases transfer to the Company substantially all the risks and benefits incidental to ownership of the leased asset. At the commencement of the lease term, the leased assets are measured at the fair value of the leased asset or, if lower, at the present value of the minimum lease payments.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;&amp;#160;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;The leased asset is depreciated over the shorter of the lease term and the expected life of the leased asset.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&#13;&lt;table id="z96a47bbf5dc94f6bac0558ec9c589be4" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&#13;&lt;tr&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="width: 85.05pt"&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.5pt"&gt;2.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Operating lease&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 113.4pt"&gt;Lease agreements are classified as an operating lease if they do not transfer substantially all the risks and benefits incidental to ownership of the leased asset. Lease payments are recognized as an expense in profit or loss on a straight-line basis over the lease term.&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForLeasesExplanatory>
    <ifrs-full:DescriptionOfAccountingPolicyForPropertyPlantAndEquipmentExplanatory contextRef="From2017-01-01to2017-12-31">&lt;div&gt;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: left"&gt;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;div style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;table id="z5a1e7d164847472d963ac54367663c63" class="DSPFListTable" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 100%"&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif; vertical-align: top; width: 28.35pt"&gt;l.&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify; width: auto"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;&lt;u&gt;Property, plant and equipment&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;/tr&gt;&#13;&lt;/table&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;Property, plant and equipment are measured at cost, including directly attributable costs and financing costs, less accumulated depreciation, accumulated impairment losses and any related investment grants and excluding day-to-day servicing expenses. Cost includes spare parts and auxiliary equipment that can be used only in connection with the plant and equipment.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;The Company's assets include computer systems comprising hardware and software. Software forming an integral part of the hardware to the extent that the hardware cannot function without the programs installed on it is classified as property, plant and equipment. In contrast, software that adds functionality to the hardware is classified as an intangible asset.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; text-align: justify; margin-left: 85.05pt"&gt;The cost of assets includes the cost of materials, direct labor costs, as well as any costs directly attributable to bringing the asset to the location and condition necessary for it to operate in the manner intended by management.&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="line-height: 1.25"&gt;&lt;br style="line-height: 1.25" /&gt;&#13;&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif; width: 76%; background-color: #cceeff; vertical-align: bottom"&gt;&#13;&lt;div&gt;Leasehold improvements&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: bottom; width: 1%; background-color: #cceeff; text-align: right; width: 9%; background-color: #cceeff; vertical-align: bottom"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;(*&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td nowrap="nowrap" style="vertical-align: bottom; text-align: left; width: 1%; background-color: #cceeff; vertical-align: bottom"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;)&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td style="vertical-align: bottom; text-align: right; width: 9%; background-color: #cceeff; vertical-align: bottom"&gt;&#13;&lt;div style="font: 10pt/1.25 Times New Roman, Times, serif"&gt;10&lt;/div&gt;&#13;&lt;/td&gt;&#13;&lt;td nowrap="nowrap" style="vertical-align: bottom;
